{{Quote|There is much untapped potential within you. You have already taken the first step. Do you seek to continue?|Antaria Wellos, to an unidentified spacer|<ref name="AED" />}}
'''Antaria Wellos''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] who had served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] in the [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] before the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the fall of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]]. While a Jedi, Wellos was considered to demonstrate a melodramatic personality uncharacteristic in her contemporaries.

==Biography==
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]], Antaria Wellos was [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] before the fall of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Declaration of a New Order]] that marked the end of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Retreating into exile, Wellos took refuge on the planet [[Rori/Legends|Rori]] where she survived the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]] initiated by the Empire. During the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Wellos was approached by a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] traveling through a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] on Rori. The spacer presented Wellos with a [[Jinsu Razor]] [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]].<ref name="AED" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Antaria Wellos was featured as a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|Non-Player Character]] in the [[Wikipedia:MMORPG|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', where she was involved in the "One-Handed Fifth Generation Lightsaber" quest.
